text: Have you seen my father? Tall, grey suit. Do not say you are not sure.
physicalText: Climb up and look over the balcony with me
magicalText: Tell me what you remember, exactly

text: Fold a crane with me. If yours is ugly, you are lying about being careful.
physicalText: Hold the paper steady while I crease it
magicalText: Fold your own and get every corner right

text: There is a beetle on the door. Get rid of it. Do not squash it.
physicalText: Lift the door off its hinge and let it walk out
magicalText: Talk it outside, slowly, like Mai does

text: Somebody laughed at me in the foyer. Were you laughing?
physicalText: Stand between me and whoever it was
magicalText: Say who it was and why it is not funny

text: Ghosts do not scare me. Do they scare you? Answer properly.
physicalText: Walk ahead of me into the dark
magicalText: Stay still and listen to it with me

text: Forgive me. There is a note in the walls I cannot place. Would you help me find it?
physicalText: Knock along the panels until it rings true
magicalText: Hum with me until the wall answers

text: My bracelet slipped beneath the stage boards. It was my mother's.
physicalText: Pry the board up for me
magicalText: Let me sing it back to my hand, and steady me

text: Would you light this incense for the old company? It would please them, I think.
physicalText: Shield the flame from the draught
magicalText: Say their names with me as it burns

text: They want me to sing at midnight. Do you think I should?
physicalText: Promise you will stand in the wings
magicalText: Tell me honestly what you hear in the hall

text: Something passed behind us. Please, which way should we go?
physicalText: Take my hand and run the long way round
magicalText: Stand still and let it pass

text: Truong Uyen Nhi is pale. Would you hold her wrist while I count?
physicalText: Keep her arm still
magicalText: Keep her talking so she does not panic

text: There is water on that floor. Would you carry me across it, or tell me it is only rain?
physicalText: Carry him over the puddle
magicalText: Convince him it is only rain

text: Why would a man keep thirty years of death certificates? Would you read them for me?
physicalText: Force the locked drawer
magicalText: Read them aloud, every name

text: Do you know how to set a splint, or shall I teach you on yourself?
physicalText: Pull the bone straight on three
magicalText: Keep him calm while he works

text: You answer my question with a question. Why do you think I do the same?
physicalText: Laugh it off and keep walking
magicalText: Answer him with a better question

text: Arm-wrestle me, boss. Loser carries the bag.
physicalText: Grip his hand and push
magicalText: Make him laugh until he loses

text: Kid, read me what this ledger says. My eyes hate small print.
physicalText: Hold the lamp and squint with him
magicalText: Read it out, numbers and all

text: There's an altar back there. Grab what's on it, I'm not touching that.
physicalText: Lift the box off the altar
magicalText: Ask the altar's leave first

text: Somebody here owes my people. You know who, boss?
physicalText: Help him lean on the door
magicalText: Talk him out of leaning on anyone

text: That student keeps filming me. Should I smash the camera?
physicalText: Hold him back by the collar
magicalText: Tell him how good he will look on it

text: A key for every door, child, but one is missing. Will you help me look?
physicalText: Move the heavy wardrobe aside
magicalText: Walk the halls with me and listen

text: Cover that mirror for me, dear. Do not look into it either.
physicalText: Lift the sheet over it
magicalText: Stand with your back to it and describe it

text: The old lift has not run since the war, child. Open its gate, or tell me what you heard behind it?
physicalText: Force the gate
magicalText: Tell her what you heard

text: Do not say his name, dear. Will you promise?
physicalText: Swear it on your hands
magicalText: Promise and mean it

text: When the river is high, which way does the reed bend? Think, child.
physicalText: Show her with your hands
magicalText: Answer her proverb with another

text: My camera's dying. Hold this torch while I swap the battery? Viewers, stay with me.
physicalText: Hold the torch rock steady
magicalText: Keep talking to his viewers for him

text: Race me to the top of the stairs, for the footage? Three, two...
physicalText: Sprint the stairs
magicalText: Count him down with real suspense

text: Is that Le Thanh? Could you ask her for one line on camera? I can't, I'm shaking.
physicalText: Steer him over to her
magicalText: Ask her kindly for him

text: Don't leave me alone in here, okay? Just for a minute?
physicalText: Stand guard in the doorway
magicalText: Talk him through the dark

text: Did you hear that? Tell my viewers what it was. Be honest.
physicalText: Go and check the noise
magicalText: Name it calmly for the camera

text: This mask is cracked along the brow. Steady it while I look? Gently.
physicalText: Hold it still with both hands
magicalText: Tell her where it was made

text: That costume would suit you, almost. Help me lift the rack down?
physicalText: Lift the rack down
magicalText: Name the opera it was made for

text: I keep a list of favours. Shall I write your name on the good side?
physicalText: Carry her case for her
magicalText: Make her laugh at her own list

text: Le Thanh's bracelets are older than she thinks. Would you ask her where they came from?
physicalText: Bring her over by the elbow
magicalText: Ask the question gracefully

text: Someone dropped a vase in the hall. Can it be saved? Tell me it can.
physicalText: Gather every shard
magicalText: Tell her it can, and convince her
